name: Hiketa (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Hiketa town emblem in white: a winged device above a ring with a small ring.
history: Flag of the former town of Hiketa in Kagawa Prefecture, dissolved on 2003-04-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1968.

features.role: Hiketa town emblem — a winged device above a ring with a small ring
